purpose: Freeze the common source, geometry, uncertainty, boundary, numerical, and dimensionality vocabulary required before any registered mechanism may be promoted from a radial or spherical proxy to an honest full three-dimensional test.

allowed_reads: the canonical configuration and implementation files of this package
the registered mechanism catalog reconstructed by that contract
forbidden_reads: cluster pressure or temperature response values
confirmation, independent, group, or environment response rows

predecessor_bindings.meaning: The completed radial campaign had zero cross-scale survivors. This is retained as counterevidence and is not reinterpreted as a full-3D test.

coordinate_and_unit_contract.spatial_chart: right-handed Cartesian source coordinates (x,y,z) with object-centred origin
coordinate_and_unit_contract.time_coordinate: declared separately for dynamical branches; static branches must not smuggle time into a spatial proxy
coordinate_and_unit_contract.length_unit: metre internally with explicit astronomical conversion metadata
coordinate_and_unit_contract.frame_rule: matter, photons, clocks, and tensor waves must name their metric or effective operator; no implicit frame switching

required_primitive_fields: rho_b(x,y,z) split into stellar, gas, compact-object, and optional plasma components
derived_source_only_fields: Phi_b from an independently specified source equation
local density, enclosed mass where symmetry permits, source compactness, and source-only environmental invariants
forbidden_source_leakage: hydrostatic or lensing inferred total mass
fitted residuals, comparator losses, labels, or survivor status
source_field_contract.deprojection_rule: No unique rho_b(x,y,z) may be inferred from a one-dimensional radial curve or a two-dimensional image without a frozen family, nuisance prior, and uncertainty propagation.
source_field_contract.external_environment_rule: External acceleration, tidal tensor, neighbour density, filament direction, and boundary field are separate source inputs, never fitted from the same response being predicted.

uncertainty_requirements: shared calibration covariance across objects when applicable
geometry_and_observation_contract.response_separation: Source reconstruction, forward prediction, and response scoring must be separate artifacts with one-way provenance.

outer: or measured external field with uncertainty
interfaces: flux jump from declared surface sources
boundary_and_initial_condition_contract.periodic: allowed only for declared cosmological boxes and never substituted for isolated galaxies or clusters
boundary_and_initial_condition_contract.initial_data: required for every hyperbolic, retarded, memory, feedback, stochastic, carrier, or wave branch
boundary_and_initial_condition_contract.gauge_and_constraints: relativistic or gauge-field branches must declare gauge, constraints, and constraint-preserving boundary treatment

minimum_checks: at least three resolutions with observed convergence order
symmetry-reduction regression to analytic spherical or axisymmetric limits
independent implementation comparison for promoted comparators
numerical_contract.failure_policy: Every nonconvergence, constraint violation, negative-energy mode, nonfinite value, branch ambiguity, and boundary sensitivity is retained as a counterexample.
numerical_contract.parameter_policy: No object-by-object retuning; common constants, preregistered nuisance distributions, and explicit indifference bands only.

synthetic_fixture_contract.shape: offset gas, stars, and compact components
clock network across static and changing sources

mechanism_requirement_contract.ontology: QG01-QG13 remain THEORY_ONLY until each is expanded into a typed executable card with field content, state space, equations or operator, source coupling, observable closure, units, limits, and falsification tests.

missing_inputs: resolved atomic and molecular gas maps
vertical thickness or a frozen deprojection family
distance, inclination, orientation, and mass-to-light covariance
external acceleration vector and tidal/environment map
two- or three-dimensional gas-density reconstruction and covariance
two-dimensional stellar, intracluster-light, and member-galaxy baryon maps
forbidden_substitutes: pressure or temperature as source fields

dimensionality_matrix_contract.ordering: mechanism catalog order, then SPARC object order, then XCOP object order

theory_expansion_queue: independent Newton/GR Poisson and weak-field metric baselines
independent AQUAL and QUMOND nonlinear solvers with external-field effect
NFW, Einasto, baryon-plus-halo, Refracted Gravity, EMOND, MOG/STVG, and nonlocal comparators
GP01 local, AQUAL, elliptic, transport, kernel, telegraph, and action branches
principal symbol, constrained degrees of freedom, Hamiltonian boundedness, conservation, hyperbolicity, causality, radiation, strong-coupling, and EFT cutoff gates
matter, photon, clock, redshift, capture, gravitational-wave, Solar, pulsar, and cosmological closures
synthetic fixtures before any new response campaign
anti_loop_rules: Do not generate more object-wise multipliers of the failed radial family unless a new field equation or falsifiable observable closure changes its equivalence class.
Do not call a 1-D or spherical proxy a full 3-D test.
Do not force wave, history, quantum, stochastic, carrier, medium, discrete, emergent, or wildcard ideas into a rotation-curve-only score.
Do not fit the response into the source map.
Do not open a new real-data campaign until its theory, source, geometry, boundary, and synthetic gates pass.

establishes: a common 3-D source and geometry contract
a deterministic metadata-only mechanism-by-object dimensionality disposition
an exact inventory of missing source inputs
does_not_establish: any theory health or observational pass
any response score, survivor, novelty, or publication claim
